validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="p">
  <state id="p" initial="a">
    <state id="a">
      <transition event="go" target="b c"/>
    </state>
    <state id="b">
      <transition event="go" target="c"/>
    </state>
    <final id="c"/>
  </state>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: transition targets `b` and `c` cannot be active at the same time

secondary.message: only one child of this state can be active

notes: both targets lie in different children of `p`, which is not a <parallel> and can have only one active child; a multi-target set must form a legal state configuration
removing `b` (keeping `c`) would leave `b` unreachable: no other transition, `initial`, or history default enters it
diagnostics.help: keep only one of these targets, or place them in different regions of a common `<parallel>` ancestor
spec_references: SCXML 1.0 §3.11 Legal State Configurations and Specifications
